notes.title: The Random Flux Update
notes.notes:
The chaos never stops in Ominoflux! 🎉

The Random Flux Update is here, mixing together tweaks, upgrades, and brand-new add-ons in true flux fashion. Here are the details:



✨ UI & Visuals

Improved campaign mode HUD, transitions and readability

Cleaner icons and sharper pixel text

Added more details to world map



⚙️ Gameplay Tweaks

Adjusted game play balance

Added a secret ultra hard quest in campaign mode

Quality-of-life changes for smoother runs

Reworked dialogue to sharpen storytelling

Expanded in-game text and descriptions

Polished up on the writing everywhere



🆕 Add-ons & Extras

New secret level added

4 new levels, 3 new monster types

Other small surprises to keep things fresh



🔧 General Improvements

Optimized loading performance

Fixed minor bugs & glitches



This game will continue to evolve. Ominoflux is a passion project, and I’ll keep supporting and expanding it indefinitely. If you do pick it up, know that more updates and surprises are always on the way.

Flux be with you!
